== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Decipher-era [[Special Modifications]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell.
